$comment: Paths allowed to write pull request state without taking a lease. Exact paths only -- no globs, because a glob stops being reviewable the moment it matches something new. Every entry names the issue that tracks it.

exceptions.reason: Dependabot's own pull requests, merged by GitHub's auto-merge once checks pass. No agent session writes here, so there is no session to serialise against; the lease exists to stop two agents racing, not to stop GitHub merging its own bot's work.
